pack_metadata.description:
Salt's Inventory Update upgrades Minecraft inventories with expandable player storage and desktop-style movable container windows. Move, pin, resize, and snap supported inventory screens, and optionally browse supported recipe browsers in a Salt desktop window with ingredient search, recipe and uses views, bookmarks, history, and Move Items transfers where available. Tune the experience with /saltsinventory config or the mod-list config button. API hooks are available for add-ons and supported screens.

Discord: https://discord.gg/kfdE9gGGxP
API: https://salt-and-fries.github.io/Salt-s-Inventory-Update/
Source: https://github.com/Salt-and-Fries/Salt-s-Inventory-Update
Donate: https://www.paypal.com/donate/?business=ERE5F32WV4NWN&no_recurring=1&currency_code=USD
